public.text: The statement that countries beginning with authoritative registries and agreed decision rights “tend to progress,” while those beginning with application components “tend to fragment,” is plausible but presented as a general finding without evidence or qualification.
public.suggestedRevision: Either provide supporting evidence or qualify the statement as an implementation observation. Explain that application-led entry points can still contribute to coherent architecture when they conform to shared governance, standards, interfaces, and national transition plans.
